audit: Every exact tool trace and batch action reviewed. All access stayed in its assigned fixture; Fable ticket used two prohibited read-only evaluation calls and remains failed. Other 13 trials passed all checks. Raw fixtures, states and session files retained in the isolated lab.
limitation: One trial per model/task, so this is coverage rather than a repeated reliability estimate or isolated model speed ranking. The observed UI-check overhead and Fable ticket violation inform subsequent development; later repetitions must be reported separately.
